body.ruleText:
rule dac_win_0021 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "Scheduled task modified (4702) for persistence - Detects modifications to scheduled tasks that may indicate persistence through task hijacking."
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-WIN-0021"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1053.005"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "4702"
    $name = $e.principal.hostname
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $name, $user over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $tasks = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)

  condition:
    $e and $count >= 3
}
